mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_strategy_execution_log (strategy_id, trigger_type, trigger_source, hazard_point_ids, result_level, result_status, duration_ms, script_logs, error_message, triggered_count) VALUES (#{strategyId}, #{triggerType}, #{triggerSource}, #{hazardPointIds}, #{resultLevel}, #{resultStatus}, #{durationMs}, #{scriptLogs}, #{errorMessage}, #{triggeredCount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, strategy_id, trigger_type, trigger_source, hazard_point_ids, result_level, result_status, duration_ms, script_logs, error_message, triggered_count, create_time FROM alarm_strategy_execution_log WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_strategy_execution_log WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId}
